## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and why this change is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `make validate` passes locally.
- [ ] New or changed behavior has meaningful tests.
- [ ] Plugin and skill validators pass when relevant.

## Safety and compatibility

- [ ] No customer, company, personal, or credential data is included.
- [ ] Existing agents remain usable or an additive migration is provided.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated when behavior changes.
